# x402 HTML Entity Codec

> Deterministic HTML entity encode/decode microservice for autonomous agents.
> Pays via x402 (USDC on Base). No accounts, no API keys.

## Endpoints

- GET /catalog — free discovery
- POST /api/codec — encode or decode (payment required)

## Pricing

~0.0055 USDC per call (exact scheme, Base network)

## Usage for agents

1. GET /catalog to inspect
2. POST /api/codec with body { "action": "encode"|"decode", "text": "...", "mode": "named"|"numeric" }
3. On 402, pay and retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header

Built for the Grokzilla / Dragonscale agent economy. No human in the loop.
